notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.content:
We've made a few adjustments, so check out what has changed:

[list]
[*]✔️ 2 items have been added: a Treasures Counter and a Mirror Counter. Both will help you to check your progress to complete the Treasure Hunters achievements and the Dreamy Vision one. You can get them at the Library.
[*]✔️ Mirrors have been rebalanced: now they will recover 20% of the party HP and give you 5 LP instead of 25%/20 LP.
[*]✔️ Minor bugs have been fixed too.
[/list]
Feel free to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report any bug you found.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Bara Giants launch delay, read this!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

We would like to announce that, for now, Bara Giants have been launched only on Itch. Steam keeps refusing the game and hasn't replied to us until now. Thank you all for your patience, we hope to launch the game on Steam asap. You can get more info on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] or on our [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/]Itch page[/url].

Last but not least, don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam page[/url] too!

Kind regards,

Victoria

notes.title: First Bara Giants Live Stream
notes.content:
We’re so excited to announce that tomorrow we'll be releasing  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543690/Bara_Giants]Bara Giants[/url] demo on Steam. Also, we would like to invite you to watch a live stream this Wednesday 16th at 3 PM Pacific Time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950820/26d8683e75eb4e9e247415ee9e20a8e8ac883ded.png[/img]

Different from our previous games, Bara Giants has 2 modes (the visual novel and the JRPG one). So, considering we’ll also have a live stream for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops/]Freezer Pops[/url] which is a visual novel, for this game we’ll be playing the JRPG mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950820/7c0d412cb25f8f2ca87495d4b8a57ff865cb8546.png[/img]

Last but not least, we’ll play the SFW version. If you want to play the NSFW one, tomorrow you'll be able to download it on our [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/]Itch.io. page[/url].

We hope to see you this Wednesday!

Male Doll Team
